alerts.title: White Rim Road and Colorado Overlook Road CLOSED AND IMPASSABLE
alerts.description: Recent rains caused rockfall, cutbanks, washouts, mud, and standing water on several backcountry roads. The Colorado Overlook Road and the western side of the White Rim Road (from Mineral Bottom to west of White Crack Junction) are CLOSED to all traffic until conditions improve. Visitors can still drive to White Crack on the eastern side of the White Rim, but a full loop is not possible at this time.

alerts.title: Trip-planning tips for 2026
alerts.description: Planning to visit Canyonlands this year? To ensure the best experience, please anticipate potentially long wait times at the entrance station. If overlook or trailhead parking is full, plan to return a little later. Please avoid parking on vegetation and roadways to help preserve this beautiful place for everyone to enjoy.
